Name: AI_SOUND_PARAM_ST
Description: AI sounds: invisible sound events that NPCs can hear, usually emitted alongside a real sound. Sets how far the sound carries, how long it lasts, who can hear it and how the hearer reacts.

Fields.Name: Radius
Fields.Description: Radius of the AI sound, in metres.

Fields.Name: Duration
Fields.Description: How long the AI sound remains, in seconds.

Fields.Name: Use SpEffect Sound Radius Rate
Fields.Description: If set, the radius is affected by the SpEffect sound radius rate.

Fields.Name: Rate Type
Fields.Description: AI sound type, which sets the rate applied to the radius.

Fields.Name: Target: Hostile
Fields.Description: If set, characters hostile to the emitter can hear the sound.

Fields.Name: Target: Friendly
Fields.Description: If set, characters friendly to the emitter can hear the sound.

Fields.Name: Target: Self
Fields.Description: If set, the emitting character itself can hear the sound.

Fields.Name: Set Search Target
Fields.Description: If ON, set the search target when sound is heard.

Fields.Name: Rank
Fields.Description: Kind of sound, which sets how the hearing character behaves.

Fields.Name: Forget Time
Fields.Description: How long a character keeps the sound as its target after hearing it, in seconds.

Fields.Name: Sound Behavior ID
Fields.Description: Behaviour ID passed to the hearing character's AI, which picks the reaction.

Fields.Name: Awareness Increase
Fields.Description: How much the search level of characters within hearing range of the sound increases. In points.

Fields.Name: Engagement Level Increase
Fields.Description: How much the engagement level of characters within hearing range of the sound increases. In points.
